## Wan 3.0 Pro API

Wan 3.0 Pro is a text to video, image to video and reference to video model by Alibaba Qwen, available on the Venice API as `wan-3-0-pro-text-to-video`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Wan 3.0 Pro is the highest-resolution tier of Alibaba's Wan 3.0, generating 2- to 30-second clips at up to 4K from text, with optional native audio.

### Wan 3.0 Pro API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wan-3-0-pro-text-to-video` | Text to video | Anonymized | from $0.2537 / sec |
| `wan-3-0-pro-image-to-video` | Image to video | Anonymized | from $0.2537 / sec |
| `wan-3-0-pro-reference-to-video` | Reference to video | Anonymized | from $0.2537 / sec |

Clip prices for `wan-3-0-pro-text-to-video`, silent:

| Duration | 1080p | 2K | 4K |
|---|---|---|---|
| Per second | $0.2537 | $0.2916 | $0.3168 |
| 2s | $0.51 | $0.58 | $0.63 |
| 5s | $1.27 | $1.46 | $1.58 |
| 10s | $2.54 | $2.92 | $3.17 |
| 30s | $7.61 | $8.75 | $9.51 |

7 lengths from 2 to 30 seconds, priced per second.

### Wan 3.0 Pro specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|

| Aspect ratios | 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4 |
| Audio | Optional |

### How to use the Wan 3.0 Pro API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "wan-3-0-pro-text-to-video"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "wan-3-0-pro-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "1080p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
    "audio": true
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "wan-3-0-pro-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
